svg.text: 1. Input checks: samplesheet, reference, every input
Target BEDs (samplesheet): the common comparison region
VCFs of all technologies (samplesheet): the main line
Ensembl VEP cache or GTF, optional (--vep)
GIAB and stratification BEDs, repeats, optional (--giab_<name>, --stratification)
Known variants, optional (--known_variants): required checklist or truth set
Reference FASTA (--fasta): every input is checked against it
A line ends at its last use. All steps: README.md
Metro-map style: nf-core components (CC0), J. A. Fellows Yates, M. U. Garcia, L. Le Nezet; after the nf-core/rnaseq metro map. Detailed map: variantcomp_metro_map.svg
